scenarios.title: A｜表达观点
scenarios.setting: 老师让大家讨论社交媒体对学生生活的影响。

turns.text: Do you think social media has had a positive or negative effect on students?

turns.prompt: 关于「课堂讨论与展示」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I think it has both positive and negative effects.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it has both positive and negative effects.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: In my opinion, it can be useful, but it can also be distracting.

feedback.naturalExpression: In my opinion, it can be useful, but it can also be distracting.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: I think it depends on how people use it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it depends on how people use it.
feedback.explanation: “it depends”表示答案取决于条件，可以接着说明哪些因素会影响决定。

choices.text: Personally, I think the negative effects are more noticeable.

feedback.naturalExpression: Personally, I think the negative effects are more noticeable.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: In my opinion, I think social media is…

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I think it has both positive and negative effects.
feedback.explanation: “In my opinion”和“I think”都表示个人看法，同时使用较重复，保留一个即可。

turns.text: Can you explain what you mean?

turns.prompt: 你想用一个例子解释自己的观点，会怎么说？

choices.text: For example, it’s useful for staying in touch, but people can spend too much time on it.

feedback.naturalExpression: For example, it’s useful for staying in touch, but people can spend too much time on it.
feedback.explanation: “staying in”指待在家、不外出，适合聊休闲偏好。

choices.text: One advantage is that information is easy to share. The downside is that it can be distracting.

feedback.naturalExpression: One advantage is that information is easy to share. The downside is that it can be distracting.
feedback.explanation: 用“advantage”和“downside”分别说明好处与不足，使观点便于比较。

choices.text: I think the main problem is that it’s very easy to lose track of time.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think the main problem is that it’s very easy to lose track of time.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: From my experience, it can be helpful when it’s used in moderation.

feedback.naturalExpression: From my experience, it can be helpful when it’s used in moderation.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

turns.text: Does anyone have a different perspective?

scenarios.title: B｜回应同学
scenarios.setting: 在“课堂讨论与展示”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“回应同学”。

turns.text: I actually think social media is mostly positive because it helps people stay connected.

turns.prompt: 你想表达认同或相似的感受，会怎么说？

choices.text: I agree. Staying connected is definitely one of the biggest advantages.

feedback.naturalExpression: I agree. Staying connected is definitely one of the biggest advantages.
feedback.explanation: 先赞同，再补充保持联系这个具体优势，让回应有内容而非只说同意。

choices.text: That’s a good point. I hadn’t thought about it that way.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s a good point. I hadn’t thought about it that way.
feedback.explanation: “I hadn’t”说明在过去某个时点之前尚未发生，能交代事情的先后关系。

choices.text: I agree to some extent, but I think there are downsides too.

feedback.naturalExpression: I agree to some extent, but I think there are downsides too.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I see what you mean, but I’m not sure I completely agree.

feedback.naturalExpression: I see what you mean, but I’m not sure I completely agree.
feedback.explanation: 直接指出没理解的词或说法，让对方解释该部分，而不必重讲全部内容。

choices.text: I agree with your opinion very much.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I agree. Staying connected is definitely one of the biggest advantages.
feedback.explanation: 这句可以表达赞同；“I agree with you”已经清楚，无需再加“your opinion very much”。

turns.text: What downsides are you thinking about?

turns.prompt: 关于「课堂讨论与展示」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: For one thing, it can be very distracting.

feedback.naturalExpression: For one thing, it can be very distracting.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I think it can become a problem when people spend too much time on it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it can become a problem when people spend too much time on it.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: There’s also the issue of misinformation.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s also the issue of misinformation.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: I’m mainly concerned about how it affects people’s attention.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m mainly concerned about how it affects people’s attention.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

turns.prompt: 你想总结自己对这个话题的看法，会怎么说？

choices.text: So I think it really depends on how it’s used.

feedback.naturalExpression: So I think it really depends on how it’s used.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Yeah. I don’t think it’s completely good or bad.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. I don’t think it’s completely good or bad.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

scenarios.title: C｜进行展示
scenarios.setting: 小组来到教室前方，玩家负责展示的开头和其中一部分。

turns.prompt: 关于「课堂讨论与展示」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, everyone. Today we’re going to talk about how social media affects students.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, everyone. Today we’re going to talk about how social media affects students.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Good morning. Our presentation today is about social media and student life.

feedback.naturalExpression: Good morning. Our presentation today is about social media and student life.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

choices.text: Today we’d like to share the results of our research on social media use among students.

feedback.naturalExpression: Today we’d like to share the results of our research on social media use among students.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Our presentation is divided into three main parts.

feedback.naturalExpression: Our presentation is divided into three main parts.
feedback.explanation: “is divided into”说明展示分成三部分，先给听众一个清晰结构。

choices.text: Today our group will introduce about social media.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, everyone. Today we’re going to talk about how social media affects students.
feedback.explanation: “introduce”直接接介绍对象，不加“about”；演讲开场也常用“talk about”引出主题。

turns.prompt: 关于「课堂讨论与展示」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: First, I’ll give you some background on the topic.

feedback.naturalExpression: First, I’ll give you some background on the topic.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: I’ll start by looking at some of the benefits.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll start by looking at some of the benefits.
feedback.explanation: “looking at”表示正在看或考虑某个对象；对方能据此了解你目前关注哪项选择。

choices.text: Then Jamie will talk about the disadvantages, and Sam will discuss our survey results.

feedback.naturalExpression: Then Jamie will talk about the disadvantages, and Sam will discuss our survey results.
feedback.explanation: 用“Then”交代后续顺序，并说清每位同学负责的部分，方便听众跟进。

turns.prompt: 关于「课堂讨论与展示」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Now let’s move on to our survey results.

feedback.naturalExpression: Now let’s move on to our survey results.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Next, I’d like to look at what students told us in the survey.

feedback.naturalExpression: Next, I’d like to look at what students told us in the survey.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: As you can see from this chart, most students use social media every day.

feedback.naturalExpression: As you can see from this chart, most students use social media every day.
feedback.explanation: “every day”表示每天重复发生，区别于只发生一次的情况。

choices.text: The most interesting result was the amount of time students spent online.

feedback.naturalExpression: The most interesting result was the amount of time students spent online.
feedback.explanation: 指出最值得关注的调查结果，让听众知道接下来应把重点放在哪里。

turns.prompt: 你已经了解所需信息，想表达感谢并结束交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s all for my part. I’ll hand it over to Jamie now.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s all for my part. I’ll hand it over to Jamie now.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Now I’ll pass things over to Jamie, who’ll talk about the disadvantages.

feedback.naturalExpression: Now I’ll pass things over to Jamie, who’ll talk about the disadvantages.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Jamie will take it from here.

feedback.naturalExpression: Jamie will take it from here.
feedback.explanation: “take it from here”表示从这里接着讲或接手，适合演示中的交接。

choices.text: And now Jamie will continue our presentation.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: That’s all for my part. I’ll hand it over to Jamie now.
feedback.explanation: 这句正确；演示交接时“Jamie will take it from here”是更口语化的接棒说法。

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: That brings us to the end of our presentation. Thanks for listening.

feedback.naturalExpression: That brings us to the end of our presentation. Thanks for listening.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: That’s everything we wanted to cover. Thank you for your attention.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s everything we wanted to cover. Thank you for your attention.
feedback.explanation: “that’s everything”表示目前没有其他需求，适合结束一次服务问答。

choices.text: Thanks for listening. We’d be happy to answer any questions.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for listening. We’d be happy to answer any questions.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。
